Actor Pradeep Rawat Dies at 74 After Battling Cancer

Actor Pradeep Rawat, known for his roles in "Lagaan" and "Ghajini," passed away at the age of 74. He had been battling cancer and reportedly had six heart blockages. Rawat, who also famously portrayed Ashwatthama in the television series "Mahabharat," died on Tuesday evening. His final rites were attended by actors including Aamir Khan and several artists from "Lagaan."
